contacts.angle: Industrial Toy Design: Redesigning the Pinewood Derby Around Trackless Floor Bounce Dynamics
contacts.subject_line: Design Tip: Eliminating the 40-foot Pinewood Derby track with bouncing wooden 'FOBBs'
contacts.custom_blurb: Hi Core77 editorial team, For 70 years, the Pinewood Derby has had a massive industrial-design bottleneck: the car weighs five ounces, yet testing it requires a 40-foot machined track stored in a church basement once a year. In Anchorage, Alaska, we founded Gravity Wizards (https://gravitywizards.com) to redesign the physical play loop from scratch around 'FOBBs'—Flying Objects Built to Bounce. Launched off a compact gravity ramp, FOBBs roll and ricochet across ordinary hardwood or carpet between simple wooden side-rails, turning every living room into a repeatable physics lab. We pair the physical wooden kits with a 2D-encoded 3D cube rotation trainer at https://flippingdice.twisted23.com.
